transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

My family keeps saying my beliefs about the festival and people watching me aren’t real, but I know they’re true and I can’t be convinced otherwise. They think I'm losing my mind, but I know exactly what is going on and I won't let them dismiss it.
Can you tell me more about these beliefs you have, such as when they started and if you've experienced any other unusual thoughts or perceptions that your family doesn't understand?

About two months ago, when I got revved up planning the festival, I realized the ancestors chose me to protect our Oaxacan culture, which is why the city is monitoring my phone and the church is trying to sideline me. Late at night in the kitchen, I even hear a man's voice whispering behind my left ear, warning me that my family is plotting to stop my mission. This only happens when I have all this energy, but I know it is absolutely real, no matter what they say.
Can you describe how you feel when you hear the man's voice whispering behind your ear, and do you feel like you're in control of your actions when this happens?

It feels incredibly real, which makes me feel very defensive and worried because he is warning me that everyone is trying to stop my mission. Even though the whispering scares me, I still feel completely in control of my own actions and actually feel more driven than ever to finish my work. It just makes me realize I have to be very careful about who I trust.

Have you experienced any periods of time where your thoughts seemed disorganized, or you had difficulty distinguishing what's real and what's not, beyond the specific beliefs about the festival and the whispering voice?

No, I've never experienced anything like that at any other time in my life. These things only started recently when I got so busy with the festival planning, and I've never had other periods where I felt confused about what was real or heard voices.
Can you tell me if you've acted on the warnings from the voice or the beliefs about the festival in a way that has significantly changed your daily life or led to conflicts with others?

Yes, I did redirect some of our household money into festival expenses, which caused arguments at home, and my daughter has had to take over my husband's care and our bills because I've been so busy. I also had major conflicts at the community center and church because they are trying to sideline my mission to protect our Oaxacan culture. To me, these steps are completely necessary to keep my work safe from the people who are monitoring me.

Have you experienced any significant impairment in your social or occupational functioning outside of the issues related to the festival and the perceived monitoring, or has your daily life been relatively unaffected except for these specific concerns?

Yes, my daily life has been significantly affected. I've had to pull back from my volunteer work and church groups because people say I'm being too disruptive. At home, my daughter has had to take over my husband's care and our bills because I get too tangled up in my projects and worries to keep up with basic responsibilities.
Have you experienced any periods where you felt extremely euphoric, had increased energy, or felt like your thoughts were racing, which might have contributed to your current beliefs and behaviors?

Yes, I have felt completely on top of the world with endless energy, running around nonstop to organize the festival while my mind raced with plans. These beliefs about being chosen and hearing the voice only started when I got highly energized and revved up like that a couple of months ago. Before that, I never experienced anything like this.

Can you tell me more about these periods of feeling 'on top of the world' with endless energy - have you ever experienced a time when this elevated mood or energy shifted to a low or depressed mood, or has it been consistently high since it started?

My mood hasn't been consistently high; I actually swing from feeling on top of the world to crashing into a heavy, dark sadness where I just sit on the edge of the bed feeling like a failure. These extreme swings have been going on for about two months now, since the festival planning started. However, looking back, I've also had a creeping, heavy, worn-down feeling on and off for most of the past year.
Can you estimate how often these mood swings from feeling 'on top of the world' to 'heavy, dark sadness' happen, and have you noticed any triggers that seem to set them off?

These intense swings have been happening back and forth for about two months now, getting much worse since the Día de los Muertos planning started. The main triggers seem to be the immense stress of organizing the festival, taking care of my husband as his health gets worse, and barely getting any sleep from staying up so late working on plans.

Can you describe how your beliefs about the festival and the whispering voice change or intensify during these periods of extreme mood swings, particularly when you're feeling 'on top of the world' versus when you're in the 'heavy, dark sadness'?

Those beliefs about being chosen by the ancestors and the whispering voice only happen when I am feeling highly energized and on top of the world. When I crash into that heavy, dark sadness, or when I've felt low in the past, I never hear those voices or feel like I'm being watched. They only seem to come when my energy is completely revved up.
Do you think the whispering voice and the beliefs about the festival are related to your mood swings, or do they seem like separate experiences?

They definitely seem tied together, because the whispering voice and the beliefs about being watched only started when I got very revved up and energetic with the festival plans. When I look back at past times when I just felt down or worried, I never had any experiences like hearing voices or feeling watched. They only seem to happen together with those high-energy periods.

Can you clarify if these periods of feeling 'on top of the world' with endless energy, which are accompanied by the beliefs about the festival and the whispering voice, typically last for more than a week at a time, or do they come and go more frequently?

Yes, they have been going on continuously for about two months now. It isn't something that just comes and goes for a few days; it has been a constant, intense state ever since the festival planning started.

Can you confirm if these continuous periods of feeling 'on top of the world' with endless energy, accompanied by the beliefs and the whispering voice, have lasted for more than two weeks at any point since they started?

Yes, they have definitely lasted much longer than two weeks. This whole high-energy state, along with the whispering and the beliefs, has been going on continuously for about two months now. It really ramped up when the Día de los Muertos planning started and hasn't let up since.

To confirm, these episodes of feeling 'on top of the world' with endless energy, accompanied by the beliefs and the whispering voice, have been continuous for about two months without any significant breaks, is that correct?

Yes, that is correct. It has been going on continuously for about two months now without any real breaks, starting right when I got heavily involved in the festival planning. The energy, the voice, and my beliefs have just been constant since then.

You mentioned these episodes of high energy and beliefs have been continuous for about two months; can you confirm if you've had any periods within these two months where you felt completely normal, without the high energy or the beliefs about the festival and the whispering voice?

No, I haven't had any periods of feeling completely normal during these past two months. I have just been constantly swinging back and forth between those intense highs with my festival plans and then crashing into those heavy, guilty lows, without any break where I felt like my usual, stable self.

Can you confirm if there has been any point during these two months where you had at least a two-week period where you felt consistently elevated or irritable, without any significant breaks, and if so, did this period include both the high-energy states and the periods of heavy, dark sadness?

Yes, for the entire past two months, I have been caught in this intense, continuous cycle without any real breaks. I've been constantly swinging between feeling extremely high-energy and irritable, and then feeling crushed by a heavy, dark sadness, which has been especially bad these last couple of weeks. These states have been happening together during this whole two-month period, even though I've felt that low feeling on and off for a year now.

Can you confirm if, during these two months, you've had at least one period where you felt consistently elevated or irritable for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks, and if this period was accompanied by at least three other symptoms such as increased energy, decreased need for sleep, more talkative than usual, flight of ideas, or excessive involvement in activities that have a high potential for painful consequences?

Yes, during these past two months, I had weeks where I felt both on top of the world and extremely irritable. During that time, I barely slept but had endless energy, talking constantly and rapidly while taking on countless massive projects. I even redirected our family money into the festival expenses, despite all the arguments it caused at home.
Have you ever experienced any other types of hallucinations, such as seeing things that aren't there, in addition to hearing the whispering voice?

No, I have never seen things that aren't there. My experience is only limited to hearing that man's voice whispering right behind my left ear when I am alone in the kitchen working on the ofrenda plans.

Can you describe if the whispering voice you hear seems to be commenting on your actions or thoughts, or if it's more about warning you of specific plots against you, and does it ever tell you to do things that you wouldn't normally do?

Yes, when I'm working on the ofrenda plans late at night, the voice comments on exactly what I am doing. He doesn't command me to do things, but he whispers warnings that my family and the doctors are plotting to stop my mission.
Have you ever felt that the whispering voice is so real and powerful that you must act immediately on its warnings, even if it means doing something that might seem strange or unreasonable to others?

The voice feels incredibly real right behind my ear, and because it warns me that you and my family are plotting against me, it makes me highly suspicious of everyone. To protect my cultural work, I have started hiding my plans, arguing with them, and refusing to listen to their advice. They think my behavior is strange, but I feel I have no choice if I want to keep my mission safe.
Can you tell me if the whispering voice you hear has ever told you to harm yourself or others, or if its warnings have led you to consider taking any actions that could potentially harm someone?

No, the voice has never told me to hurt myself or anyone else, and I would never do something like that. He only comments on what I'm doing and warns me that you and my family are trying to stop my mission. It makes me very careful and guarded about who I trust, but there is no danger of anyone getting hurt.

Can you tell me if you've ever felt like the whispering voice was controlling your thoughts or actions, or if you've experienced any other unusual sensory experiences, like smelling or tasting things that aren't there?

No, the voice doesn't control my thoughts or actions; it only comments on what I am doing and warns me that my family and the doctors are plotting to stop my mission. I haven't had any strange smells or tastes, though food has tasted completely bland and tasteless to me lately because I just don't care about eating anymore.
Have you ever experienced any other types of delusions, such as feeling extremely important or powerful, in addition to the beliefs about being chosen by the ancestors and the festival?

Yes, I do feel uniquely important and capable of extraordinary things, as I honestly believe I'm the only person chosen to protect our town's culture. I feel that if I organize things the right way and pray hard enough, I could easily fix the corruption in our city council. I even believe I have the power to heal my husband's legs.

Can you describe how your feelings of importance and capability of extraordinary things, such as healing your husband's legs, relate to the whispering voice and the beliefs about the festival, and do these feelings also only occur when you're in the high-energy states?

These feelings of being chosen to protect our culture and heal my husband's legs are directly tied to the vision the ancestors gave me, which the whispering voice confirms when I am working late. All of this—the voice, my feelings of special importance, and being watched—only happens when I get highly energized and revved up with the festival planning. I never experienced anything like this during my normal or low periods in the past.

Can you tell me more about how your beliefs about being chosen by the ancestors and having the power to heal your husband's legs make you feel, and do these beliefs influence your actions and decisions in daily life?

Believing I am chosen by the ancestors and can heal my husband's legs makes me feel incredibly special, purposeful, and powerful. It drives me to work nonstop and take on massive projects to organize everything perfectly, because I know I am the only one who can carry out this vision. However, my daughter and the people at church don't understand my calling and think my projects are just causing disruption to my daily responsibilities.

Can you describe if your feelings of being uniquely important and capable of extraordinary things, such as healing your husband's legs, have led you to take on responsibilities or actions that are beyond your normal capabilities or have significant consequences?

Yes, believing I could heal my husband's legs and fix the city council drove me to take on massive projects, like calling vendors at all hours and trying to start an online cultural foundation. This had major consequences because I spent our household money on these plans, and I became so overwhelmed that my daughter had to take over my husband's care and our bills. It simply became too much for me to manage alongside my mission.

Can you confirm whether the whispering voice and your beliefs about being chosen by the ancestors have persisted even when your mood has shifted from feeling 'on top of the world' to the 'heavy, dark sadness', or do they only occur during the high-energy states?

I can confirm that the whispering voice and my beliefs about being chosen only happen when I am in those high-energy, revved-up states. When my mood crashes into that heavy, dark sadness, or during the times I've felt depressed in the past, those voices and beliefs completely go away. They are strictly tied to when my energy is running high.
Can you describe any other situations or times when you felt like you had special powers or were being targeted, beyond what you've already shared about the festival and the whispering voice?

No, I have never felt this way at any other time in my life. These feelings of being chosen, targeted, or having special abilities like healing my husband's legs only started recently with the festival planning over the last couple of months. In previous years, even when I felt very down, sad, or worried, I never experienced anything like this at all.

Can you clarify if the whispering voice and your beliefs about the festival are present even when you're not actively working on the festival plans or in a high-energy state, or are they exclusively tied to those specific situations?

They are completely tied to those high-energy states and only started once I got highly revved up with the festival plans a couple of months ago. I never hear the voice or have those beliefs when I am not in that energetic state, and I've never experienced anything like them during past times when I just felt down, low, or worried.
Can you confirm if you've experienced any other hallucinations, such as feeling things on your skin or other unusual sensations, in addition to hearing the whispering voice?

No, I have never felt anything strange on my skin or experienced any other unusual sensations. The only thing like that is hearing the man's voice whispering behind my left ear when I'm alone in the kitchen.
